subject: Marketplace private offer pricing - unit price mapping for BrightCart
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@amazon.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace private offer pricing - unit price mapping for BrightCart

Hi Daniel / BrightCart team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap + action items from our side and a couple asks to help the Marketplace private offer flow:

Recap
- BrightCart is planning a phased rollout of Redwood inference for recommendation & search (text generation) and vector search (embeddings).
- Expected starting cadence: 10M tokens/month, ramping to ~50M tokens/month over Q3.
- Compliance and private billing (AWS Private Offer) are blockers for procurement.

Asks / next steps
1) AWS: can you confirm how the private offer SKU mapping works for usage-based pricing? Specifically: do you prefer a USD/unit expressed per 1M tokens SKU (e.g., "redwood-gen-1m-tokens") vs per-1k-tokens? Any marketplace surcharge % we should model?
2) BrightCart: please confirm the expected monthly volume bucket (10–50M range is fine for now) and whether a single combined SKU (all inference) is preferable or two SKUs (completions vs embeddings).
3) We attached a short spreadsheet with our proposed SKU names and suggested gross prices; it includes net target unit economics on the last tab.

Target economics (source for AWS mapping)
- Redwood target net: $200 / 1M tokens (text generation, typical medium-quality model profile)
- For embeddings we expect lower cost per 1M tokens; propose $80 / 1M tokens as a starting net target.
- We expect marketplace fees + billing flow will need a small gross-up; looking for AWS to confirm typical marketplace fee (we modeled 10–15% in the attached).

Please reply with how you prefer the SKU granularity and if AWS can draft a preliminary private offer example with two SKU lines (text-gen 1M tokens, embed 1M tokens) and sample gross prices inclusive of marketplace fees.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate on our side once we get AWS guidance.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_price_mapping_v1.xlsx, BrightCart-MAP-PO-Checklist.pdf

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-03-21T12:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer pricing - unit price mapping for BrightCart

Hi Marissa — great to meet today, and thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers and next steps from AWS Marketplace side: 

SKU granularity and unit definition
- AWS Marketplace supports usage-based pricing with custom units. Expressing a unit as "1M tokens" is fine and common for LLM providers. We also support per-1k units if you prefer finer granularity, but 1M-token SKUs are easier for buyers to reason about on larger volumes.

Marketplace fees / mapping
- Typical Marketplace fees are 8–12% for Private Offers (varies by negotiated terms and whether you use consolidated billing). We recommend modeling a 10% marketplace fee to start.
- AWS will accept a private offer that lists gross prices per SKU (what the buyer pays) and you can indicate Redwood's desired net pricing when we submit the internal routing.

Suggested handshake workflow
1) Redwood proposes SKU names and gross price targets per 1M tokens (two lines: text-gen, embeddings).
2) AWS Marketplace creates a draft Private Offer and confirms fee adjustments.
3) BrightCart confirms PO details and we route to seller account for acceptance.

Quick ballpark on price mapping (examples; final needs Redwood input):
- Text-gen (1M tokens): gross price range to list in Private Offer: $220–$260 / 1M tokens (to net Redwood ~$200 after a ~10% fee).
- Embeddings (1M tokens): gross price range: $88–$95 / 1M tokens (to net Redwood ~$80 after fees).

If you send the finalized spreadsheet with SKU names and your ideal net price, I can draft a Private Offer and return the exact gross prices AWS will display (we'll also call out whether consolidated billing or direct billing affects the numbers).

I can also set up a short call with our Private Offers specialist to walk through the PO submission if you want.

Thanks,
Daniel
AWS Marketplace

On a side note: please include the expected monthly volume bucket in the spreadsheet, as that helps internal procurement approvals on our side.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@amazon.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer pricing - unit price mapping for BrightCart

Thanks Daniel — this is helpful. A couple internal clarifications to make AWS mapping straightforward: 

1) Redwood net targets (confirmed)
- Text generation (standard gen profile): target net $200 / 1M tokens. This is the price we need to receive after marketplace fees and any reseller adjustments.
- Embeddings: target net $80 / 1M tokens.

2) Gross price math (we modeled)
- If marketplace fee = 10%: gross_price = net_target / (1 - fee)
  - Text-gen gross = 200 / 0.9 = $222.22 => round to $225 as a clean SKU price.
  - Embeddings gross = 80 / 0.9 = $88.89 => round to $90.
- If fee = 12% we land at gross ~$227 / $91. Use the gross-range Daniel suggested ($220–260 and $88–95) as acceptable.

3) SKU preferences
- We prefer two SKUs: redwood_textgen_1M_tokens and redwood_embeddings_1M_tokens. Keeps billing/usage reporting clean for the customer and for our internal cost tracking.

4) Volumes and discounts
- BrightCart volume band: confirm 10–50M / month. If they commit to >50M, we can discuss an additional tiered discount (negotiated via Private Offer).

Action for Marissa: I attached a quick calc tab with the rounding rules and suggested gross SKU prices ($225 and $90) — can you push the updated sheet to AWS / Daniel and ask for a draft PO?

-Aditya
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@amazon.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer pricing - unit price mapping for BrightCart

Thanks everyone — moving this forward.

Summary / next steps
- Redwood will submit the attached spreadsheet (redwood_marketplace_price_mapping_v1.xlsx) with two SKUs and suggested gross prices:
  - redwood_textgen_1M_tokens => $225 / 1M tokens
  - redwood_embeddings_1M_tokens => $90 / 1M tokens
- Daniel / AWS: please draft a preliminary Private Offer with those two SKUs and return the exact gross prices after fees and any billing adjustments. If AWS prefers per-1k-unit SKUs for UI reasons, please show the equivalent mapping in the draft.
- BrightCart procurement: confirm your expected monthly band (10–50M is fine for now) and whether you want a single combined invoice or separate lines for generation vs embeddings.
- If BrightCart confirms >50M/month, we will propose a tiered discount for the Private Offer and loop in legal for PO terms.
- Proposed short sync to review draft PO: Tue 2026-03-24 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 2026-03-25 14:00–14:30 PT — let me know what works.

Attaching the spreadsheet and PO checklist again.

Cheers,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
